**Role:** Central bank / TARGETDKK account authority

**Reporting coverage:** TARGETDKK ISO 20022 A2A framework; exact CAMT reporting messages not established from reviewed source

**Messages / versions:** ISO20022 A2A; message numbers not evidenced
